text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Ugh!?
There are even more jellyfish.
What a pain~
text_block_list.orig_text:
げっ！？
クラゲ増えてるし。
だる～

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text:
Getting stung by jellyfish hurts, so no thanks!
And if they attack us, we'll probably end up numb too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
クラゲに刺されると、
痛いからイヤっ！
攻撃されたら
体もしびれそうだし……

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Compared to the big one, the little ones look weaker.
Wouldn't it be better to take them out first?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっきいのに比べたら、
ちっちゃいほうが弱そうだし、
先に倒したほうがよさそーじゃね？

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text:
Yep, let's do that!
I don't want my thrall seeing my skin all covered in jellyfish stings!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
それでいこ！
クラゲに刺されたお肌なんて、
けんぞくに見せたくないもんっ！
